map.发朋友圈长图被压缩，想切成九宫格拼回大图。: A long image posted to moments gets compressed, so cut it into a nine-grid to reassemble the large image.
map.做九格海报合集，每格独立保存。: Make a nine-cell poster set with each cell saved separately.
map.正方形图 900×900，按 3×3 均分，每格 300×300，导出 9 张编: A square image of 900×900 divided evenly into 3×3 gives each cell 300×300 and exports 9 PNGs numbered 1–9.
map.上传图片后显示切割参数。: Upload an image to see slicing parameters.
map.通用切分：共“行数 × 列数”片（1–6 行、1–6 列，最多 36 片）。等尺: General slicing: rows × columns pieces (1–6 rows, 1–6 columns, up to 36). In equal mode, output width = total side ÷ columns (rounded) and height = total side ÷ rows (rounded); source cells are scaled to the same size. Original-resolution mode divides the cropped source evenly, rounding when needed. Pixel-exact mode uses integer boundaries; the last piece may differ by 1 px, while the stitched total keeps the crop size. Cell (row, column) starts at crop origin + (column − 1) × source cell width and + (row − 1) × source cell height. Non-square images can be square-cropped at center/top/bottom/left/right or a custom offset, fitted with padding, or sliced at the original aspect ratio.
map.像素保真（整数边界，末片可能不同）: Pixel-exact (integer boundaries, last piece may differ)
map.上传后显示取景预览。: The crop preview appears after you upload an image.
map.总边长按行列分配；不能整除时按取整输出，信息栏会显示实际每片与拼回尺寸。微信九宫: The total side is divided by rows and columns; when not divisible, rounded sizes are used and the info line shows actual tile and stitched sizes. Publish WeChat nine-grid images in 1→9 order.
map.📚 深度解析：九宫格切图（自定义网格与取景）: 📚 In-depth analysis: custom grids and crop controls
map.1200×1200 按 3×3 每格 400×400；切 3×4 时按总边长分配: At 3×3, a 1200×1200 image gives 400×400 cells; at 3×4 the total side is divided into 12 cells of about 400×300.
map.选择居中裁方得到 600×600；人物偏左时用“偏左”或自定义 X 偏移，把关键: Center square crop gives 600×600; if the subject is on the left, use “left aligned” or a custom X offset to put them inside the crop frame.
map.非正方形图怎么切？: How do you cut a non-square image?
map.可选择居中、偏上/下/左/右或自定义偏移裁成正方形；也可选择适应留白保留整图，或: Choose center, top/bottom/left/right or a custom offset for a square crop; alternatively fit the whole image with padding, or slice at the original aspect ratio.
map.等尺寸模式按总输出边长 ÷ 行/列数得到每片尺寸；像素保真模式按整数边界切分，末: Equal mode uses total side ÷ rows/columns for each piece; pixel-exact mode uses integer boundaries, the last piece may differ, and the stitched total keeps the crop size.
map.按行优先从左到右、从上到下发布，编号 1 到最后一格，即可还原原图。: Publish in row-major order from left to right and top to bottom, numbered 1 to the last cell, to reconstruct the image.
map.按 1–6 行 × 1–6 列自定义切图，支持九宫格、四宫格、横竖六宫格预设，可: Split into custom 1–6 rows × 1–6 columns with 3×3, 2×2, 3×2 and 2×3 presets; adjust crop position, fit with padding or slice at the original aspect; export equal-size or pixel-exact PNG tiles.
